workType.description: Structural content form of the work (not its distribution format).

uri.description: Optional canonical URI for this work or edition. Runtime validation MUST restrict this to https:// or at:// values.

dracomeKey.description: Optional proprietary Dracome catalog key for this work or edition. Dracome's own systems use it both for internal lookups and as the identifier accepted by Dracome's XRPC API calls; it is not a portable identifier, so consumers outside Dracome's own systems should resolve via identifiers instead.

identifiers.description: External identifiers (ISBNs, Open Library keys, etc.) that let any client resolve this work or edition without depending on Dracome-specific data.

catalogRef.description: A portable reference to a work or edition in the Dracome catalog, intended to remain resolvable outside of Dracome's own systems.

work.description: The work being targeted by this record. Always present.

edition.description: The specific edition being targeted. Always present.

catalogTarget.description: Exact target identity for an edition-scoped record. Carries the edition and its parent work; there is no work-only target.

editionFormat.description: Physical or media format of a specific edition. The set of known values is derived from the Dracome catalog's own normalized edition-format values and may grow; consumers MUST tolerate unknown values.

title.description: Primary title of the work, sourced from the work's own canonical title.

edition.description: Edition-scoped metadata of the targeted edition. Always present.

subtitle.description: Secondary title of the work, present only when the work has one, sourced from the work's own canonical subtitle.

workType.description: Structural content form of the referenced work (novel, poetry, comic, manga, audio_drama, or non_fiction).

contributors.description: Ordered list of contributors (authors, translators, illustrators, etc.) credited on the work or edition. May be empty when the work has no credited contributor.

catalogSnapshot.description: A portable, identity-oriented snapshot of combined work-and-edition catalog metadata, captured at record write time. Alongside the record's target, it lets any AT Protocol consumer independently resolve this work or edition without depending on Dracome as a central catalog authority. Work-scoped fields are always present at the top level; edition-scoped fields are grouped under the nested `edition` sub-object, which is always present.

value.description: The identifier value itself, formatted according to scheme (for example the raw ISBN digits, or an Open Library key such as OL12345W).

scheme.description: The identifier scheme: `isbn-10` (ISBN-10), `isbn-13` (ISBN-13), `ol-work` (Open Library work key, e.g. OL12345W), `ol-edition` (Open Library edition key, e.g. OL12345M), `bookhive` (BookHive proprietary ID), `dnb` (German National Library ID), `gnd` (GND authority record number), `viaf` (VIAF ID), `wikidata` (Wikidata entity), `oclc` (OCLC WorldCat ID).

catalogIdentifier.description: A single external identifier for a work or edition, such as an ISBN or an Open Library key.

name.description: Display name of the credited person, in natural reading order (given name(s) before family name, e.g. 'Jane Doe', not library-cataloging-style 'Doe, Jane').

role.description: The role this person held in creating this work or edition (e.g. author, translator, illustrator).

contributor.description: Optional reference to this person's contributor profile, when such a profile is known to exist on their PDS.

snapshotContributor.description: A person credited on a work or edition. The role and display name are always present. The profile reference is optional, carrying the AT-URI of that person's contributor profile when one exists and is known.

title.description: Primary title of the specific edition, present only when it is captured independently of the work's canonical title — for example a translated edition's title. When present, this is authoritative for display over the top-level work title.

format.description: Physical or media format of the specific edition, if known.

language.description: ISO 639-1 or BCP 47 language code for the edition language.

subtitle.description: Secondary title of the specific edition, present only when the edition has one. When present, this is authoritative for display over the top-level work subtitle.

pageCount.description: Number of pages in the specific edition, if known. Not populated when the edition's format is audiobook; see durationSeconds.

publisherName.description: Name of the publisher of the specific edition, if known.

durationSeconds.description: Total duration in seconds for audiobook editions, captured at record write time. Only populated when the edition's format is audiobook; pageCount and durationSeconds are never both set on the same snapshot.

publicationYear.description: Year the specific edition was published. This is the edition's publication year, not necessarily the original work's first publication year.

catalogSnapshotEdition.description: Edition-scoped metadata nested inside #catalogSnapshot. All fields are independently optional.
